items.question: Trong câu "Titles vary between companies, but the ladder really reflects how much autonomy and reach you have, not how many years you have worked.", từ "ladder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Titles vary between companies, but the ladder really reflects how much autonomy and reach you have, not how many years you have worked.", what does "ladder" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a frame with steps to climb
items.explanation: ladder /ˈlæd.ɚ/ (danh từ): nấc thang sự nghiệp. Cụm hay gặp: career ladder (nấc thang sự nghiệp), climb the ladder (thăng tiến).
items.explanationEn: ladder /ˈlæd.ɚ/ (noun): a series of career levels. Common phrases: career ladder, climb the ladder (get promoted).

items.question: Trong câu "Titles vary between companies, but the ladder really reflects how much autonomy and reach you have, not how many years you have worked.", từ "reflect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Titles vary between companies, but the ladder really reflects how much autonomy and reach you have, not how many years you have worked.", what does "reflect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reflect /rɪˈflekt/ (động từ): phản ánh, thể hiện. "Pay reflects difficulty" = lương phản ánh độ khó; "reflect on" lại là suy ngẫm về.
items.explanationEn: reflect /rɪˈflekt/ (verb): to show or indicate. "Pay reflects difficulty" means pay shows it; "reflect on" means to think deeply about.

items.question: Trong câu "Titles vary between companies, but the ladder really reflects how much autonomy and reach you have, not how many years you have worked.", từ "autonomy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Titles vary between companies, but the ladder really reflects how much autonomy and reach you have, not how many years you have worked.", what does "autonomy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: autonomy /ɑːˈtɑː.nə.mi/ (danh từ): quyền tự chủ. Tính từ: autonomous (tự chủ); cấp càng cao, BA càng có nhiều "autonomy".
items.explanationEn: autonomy /ɑːˈtɑː.nə.mi/ (noun): freedom to decide alone. Adjective: autonomous; the higher the level, the more autonomy a BA has.

items.question: Trong câu "Titles vary between companies, but the ladder really reflects how much autonomy and reach you have, not how many years you have worked.", từ "reach" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Titles vary between companies, but the ladder really reflects how much autonomy and reach you have, not how many years you have worked.", what does "reach" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reach /riːtʃ/ (danh từ): tầm ảnh hưởng. "Reach" ở đây là phạm vi ảnh hưởng của bạn (một tính năng, một sản phẩm hay cả tổ chức).
items.explanationEn: reach /riːtʃ/ (noun): range of influence. Here "reach" is how widely your work has influence: one feature, a product, or the whole organization.

items.question: Trong câu "Handles a medium feature alone; still needs review on complex requirements", từ "handle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Handles a medium feature alone; still needs review on complex requirements", what does "handle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (động từ): xử lý, đảm nhận. Cụm hay gặp: handle a task (đảm nhận việc), handle pressure (chịu được áp lực).
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (verb): to deal with. Common collocations: handle a task, handle pressure.

items.question: Trong câu "Handles ambiguity and conflicting stakeholders; leads analysis on large projects", từ "conflicting" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Handles ambiguity and conflicting stakeholders; leads analysis on large projects", what does "conflicting" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: conflicting /kənˈflɪk.tɪŋ/ (tính từ): mâu thuẫn, xung đột. "Conflicting stakeholders" = các bên liên quan có mong muốn trái ngược; danh từ: conflict.
items.explanationEn: conflicting /kənˈflɪk.tɪŋ/ (adjective): opposing each other. "Conflicting stakeholders" want opposite things; noun: conflict.

items.question: Trong câu "Leads a BA team, builds process and documentation standards, trains newcomers", từ "standard" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Leads a BA team, builds process and documentation standards, trains newcomers", what does "standard" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: standard /ˈstæn.dɚd/ (danh từ): tiêu chuẩn. Cụm hay gặp: set standards (đặt tiêu chuẩn), industry standard (chuẩn ngành).
items.explanationEn: standard /ˈstæn.dɚd/ (noun): an agreed level of quality. Common phrases: set standards, industry standard.

items.question: Trong câu "Advises at organizational level; shapes how the business does analysis", từ "shape" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Advises at organizational level; shapes how the business does analysis", what does "shape" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shape /ʃeɪp/ (động từ): định hình. Động từ "shape" = định hình, tác động đến cách một thứ phát triển; danh từ là hình dạng.
items.explanationEn: shape /ʃeɪp/ (verb): to influence the form of. The verb "shape" means to influence how something develops; the noun means an outline or form.

items.question: Trong câu "What really separates the levels is not documentation technique but how much ambiguity you can absorb.", từ "absorb" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What really separates the levels is not documentation technique but how much ambiguity you can absorb.", what does "absorb" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take in and cope with
items.explanation: absorb /əbˈzɔːrb/ (động từ): tiếp nhận và xử lý. "Absorb ambiguity" = chịu đựng và xử lý được sự mơ hồ; nghĩa đen là thấm hút.
items.explanationEn: absorb /əbˈzɔːrb/ (verb): to take in and cope with. "Absorb ambiguity" means taking in unclear situations and coping; literally, to soak up.

items.question: Trong câu "and turns it into a grounded set of requirements.", từ "grounded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "and turns it into a grounded set of requirements.", what does "grounded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: grounded /ˈɡraʊn.dɪd/ (tính từ): có cơ sở vững chắc. "Grounded requirements" = yêu cầu dựa trên dữ liệu và thực tế; "be grounded" với trẻ em lại là bị cấm túc.
items.explanationEn: grounded /ˈɡraʊn.dɪd/ (adjective): well-founded. "Grounded requirements" are based on facts; for a child, "be grounded" means not allowed out.

items.question: Trong câu "The figures below are indicative ranges for the Vietnamese market and shift with time, city, company type, and English ability.", từ "indicative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The figures below are indicative ranges for the Vietnamese market and shift with time, city, company type, and English ability.", what does "indicative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: indicative /ɪnˈdɪk.ə.t̬ɪv/ (tính từ): mang tính tham khảo. "Indicative ranges" = khoảng số liệu chỉ để tham khảo; động từ: indicate (chỉ ra).
items.explanationEn: indicative /ɪnˈdɪk.ə.t̬ɪv/ (adjective): giving a rough idea. "Indicative ranges" give only a rough idea; verb: indicate.

items.question: Trong câu "The figures below are indicative ranges for the Vietnamese market and shift with time, city, company type, and English ability.", từ "range" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The figures below are indicative ranges for the Vietnamese market and shift with time, city, company type, and English ability.", what does "range" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: range /reɪndʒ/ (danh từ): khoảng giá trị. Cụm hay gặp: salary range (khung lương), a wide range of (rất nhiều loại).
items.explanationEn: range /reɪndʒ/ (noun): a span between limits. Common phrases: salary range, a wide range of.

items.question: Trong câu "The four factors that move these numbers most:", từ "factor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The four factors that move these numbers most:", what does "factor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an element that has an effect
items.explanation: factor /ˈfæk.tɚ/ (danh từ): yếu tố. Cụm hay gặp: key factor (yếu tố then chốt), risk factor (yếu tố rủi ro).
items.explanationEn: factor /ˈfæk.tɚ/ (noun): an element that has an effect. Common phrases: key factor, risk factor.

items.question: Trong câu "BAs working directly with overseas customers earn considerably more than those serving only the domestic market.", từ "overseas" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BAs working directly with overseas customers earn considerably more than those serving only the domestic market.", what does "overseas" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: overseas /ˌoʊ.vɚˈsiːz/ (tính từ): ở nước ngoài. "Overseas customers" = khách hàng nước ngoài; đồng nghĩa: foreign.
items.explanationEn: overseas /ˌoʊ.vɚˈsiːz/ (adjective): from abroad. "Overseas customers" are customers abroad; synonym: foreign.

items.question: Trong câu "BAs working directly with overseas customers earn considerably more than those serving only the domestic market.", từ "considerably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BAs working directly with overseas customers earn considerably more than those serving only the domestic market.", what does "considerably" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: considerably /kənˈsɪd.ɚ.ə.bli/ (trạng từ): đáng kể. Đừng nhầm considerable (đáng kể) với considerate (chu đáo).
items.explanationEn: considerably /kənˈsɪd.ɚ.ə.bli/ (adverb): significantly. Do not confuse considerable (large) with considerate (thoughtful).

items.question: Trong câu "BAs working directly with overseas customers earn considerably more than those serving only the domestic market.", từ "domestic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BAs working directly with overseas customers earn considerably more than those serving only the domestic market.", what does "domestic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: domestic /dəˈmes.tɪk/ (tính từ): trong nước, nội địa. "Domestic market" = thị trường trong nước; "domestic work" lại là việc nhà.
items.explanationEn: domestic /dəˈmes.tɪk/ (adjective): within the country. "Domestic market" is the home-country market; "domestic work" means housework.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA who knows finance, banking, insurance, healthcare, or logistics deeply is paid more than a generalist.", từ "generalist" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA who knows finance, banking, insurance, healthcare, or logistics deeply is paid more than a generalist.", what does "generalist" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: generalist /ˈdʒen.ɚ.əl.ɪst/ (danh từ): người làm tổng quát. Trái nghĩa: specialist (chuyên gia một lĩnh vực).
items.explanationEn: generalist /ˈdʒen.ɚ.əl.ɪst/ (noun): someone with broad skills. Opposite: specialist.

items.question: Trong câu "Product companies and foreign firms typically pay above small outsourcing shops.", từ "firm" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Product companies and foreign firms typically pay above small outsourcing shops.", what does "firm" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: firm /fɝːm/ (danh từ): công ty. Là danh từ, "firm" = công ty (law firm, consulting firm); là tính từ = chắc chắn.
items.explanationEn: firm /fɝːm/ (noun): a company. As a noun, a firm is a company (law firm, consulting firm); as an adjective it means solid.

items.question: Trong câu "Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi pay above the provinces.", từ "province" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi pay above the provinces.", what does "province" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: province /ˈprɑː.vɪns/ (danh từ): các tỉnh (ngoài đô thị lớn). "The provinces" = các tỉnh ngoài thành phố lớn; tính từ: provincial.
items.explanationEn: province /ˈprɑː.vɪns/ (noun): areas outside big cities. "The provinces" are the areas outside the major cities; adjective: provincial.

items.question: Trong câu "Job-hopping for raises without growing your ability to handle ambiguity hits a ceiling fast.", từ "job-hopping" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Job-hopping for raises without growing your ability to handle ambiguity hits a ceiling fast.", what does "job-hopping" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: job-hopping /ˈdʒɑːb ˌhɑː.pɪŋ/ (danh từ): nhảy việc liên tục. Động từ: job-hop; "job-hopper" là người hay nhảy việc.
items.explanationEn: job-hopping /ˈdʒɑːb ˌhɑː.pɪŋ/ (noun): changing jobs often. Verb: job-hop; a job-hopper changes jobs often.

items.question: Trong câu "Job-hopping for raises without growing your ability to handle ambiguity hits a ceiling fast.", từ "raise" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Job-hopping for raises without growing your ability to handle ambiguity hits a ceiling fast.", what does "raise" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: raise /reɪz/ (danh từ): khoản tăng lương. Cụm hay gặp: get a raise, ask for a raise (xin tăng lương).
items.explanationEn: raise /reɪz/ (noun): an increase in pay. Common phrases: get a raise, ask for a raise.

items.question: Trong câu "Job-hopping for raises without growing your ability to handle ambiguity hits a ceiling fast.", từ "ceiling" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Job-hopping for raises without growing your ability to handle ambiguity hits a ceiling fast.", what does "ceiling" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ceiling /ˈsiː.lɪŋ/ (danh từ): giới hạn trần. "Hit a ceiling" = chạm trần, không thể tiến thêm; cụm: glass ceiling (rào cản vô hình).
items.explanationEn: ceiling /ˈsiː.lɪŋ/ (noun): an upper limit. "Hit a ceiling" means reaching a limit you cannot pass; phrase: glass ceiling.

items.question: Trong câu "BA is one of the best-connected positions, because you understand both business and technology.", từ "position" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BA is one of the best-connected positions, because you understand both business and technology.", what does "position" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: position /pəˈzɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): vị trí công việc. Cụm hay gặp: apply for a position (ứng tuyển vị trí), open position (vị trí đang tuyển).
items.explanationEn: position /pəˈzɪʃ.ən/ (noun): a job or role. Common phrases: apply for a position, open position.

items.question: Trong câu "The focus shifts to schedule, resources, and risk.", từ "shift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The focus shifts to schedule, resources, and risk.", what does "shift" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shift /ʃɪft/ (động từ): chuyển dịch. "The focus shifts to" = trọng tâm chuyển sang; cụm: shift priorities.
items.explanationEn: shift /ʃɪft/ (verb): to move to. "The focus shifts to" means attention moves to; phrase: shift priorities.

items.question: Trong câu "The focus shifts to schedule, resources, and risk.", từ "focus" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The focus shifts to schedule, resources, and risk.", what does "focus" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: focus /ˈfoʊ.kəs/ (danh từ): trọng tâm. Cụm hay gặp: focus on (tập trung vào), main focus (trọng tâm chính).
items.explanationEn: focus /ˈfoʊ.kəs/ (noun): the main point of attention. Common phrases: focus on, main focus.

items.question: Trong câu "The focus shifts to schedule, resources, and risk.", từ "schedule" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The focus shifts to schedule, resources, and risk.", what does "schedule" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: schedule /ˈskedʒ.uːl/ (danh từ): tiến độ, lịch trình. Cụm hay gặp: on schedule (đúng tiến độ), behind schedule (chậm tiến độ).
items.explanationEn: schedule /ˈskedʒ.uːl/ (noun): a timetable of work. Common phrases: on schedule, behind schedule.

items.question: Trong câu "Working across many clients and industries.", từ "client" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Working across many clients and industries.", what does "client" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: client /ˈklaɪ.ənt/ (danh từ): khách hàng (dịch vụ). "Client" thường dùng cho khách hàng dịch vụ chuyên nghiệp (tư vấn, luật); trong IT còn là máy khách.
items.explanationEn: client /ˈklaɪ.ənt/ (noun): a customer of a service. "Client" is often used for customers of professional services; in IT it can also mean client software.

items.question: Trong câu "Working across many clients and industries.", từ "industry" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Working across many clients and industries.", what does "industry" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: industry /ˈɪn.də.stri/ (danh từ): ngành, lĩnh vực. Cụm hay gặp: banking industry (ngành ngân hàng); tính từ "industrious" lại là cần cù.
items.explanationEn: industry /ˈɪn.də.stri/ (noun): a business sector. Common phrase: banking industry; the adjective "industrious" means hard-working.

items.question: Trong câu "BA → System Analyst → Solution Architect, if you prefer system design over business analysis.", từ "prefer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BA → System Analyst → Solution Architect, if you prefer system design over business analysis.", what does "prefer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prefer /prɪˈfɝː/ (động từ): thích hơn. Cấu trúc: prefer A over/to B = thích A hơn B; danh từ: preference.
items.explanationEn: prefer /prɪˈfɝː/ (verb): to like better. Pattern: prefer A over/to B; noun: preference.

items.question: Trong câu "Many people ask whether a matching degree is required.", từ "matching" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many people ask whether a matching degree is required.", what does "matching" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: matching /ˈmætʃ.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): phù hợp, đúng ngành. "A matching degree" = bằng đúng chuyên ngành; động từ: match (khớp, phù hợp).
items.explanationEn: matching /ˈmætʃ.ɪŋ/ (adjective): corresponding, relevant. "A matching degree" is one in the related field; verb: match.

items.question: Trong câu "Many people ask whether a matching degree is required.", từ "degree" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many people ask whether a matching degree is required.", what does "degree" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: degree /dɪˈɡriː/ (danh từ): bằng cấp. Cụm hay gặp: bachelor's degree (bằng cử nhân); "to some degree" lại là ở mức độ nào đó.
items.explanationEn: degree /dɪˈɡriː/ (noun): a university qualification. Common phrase: bachelor's degree; "to some degree" means to some extent.

items.question: Trong câu "The practical answer: not mandatory, but you must compensate with foundational knowledge.", từ "practical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The practical answer: not mandatory, but you must compensate with foundational knowledge.", what does "practical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: practical /ˈpræk.tɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): thực tế, thiết thực. Cụm hay gặp: practical advice (lời khuyên thiết thực), practical experience (kinh nghiệm thực tế).
items.explanationEn: practical /ˈpræk.tɪ.kəl/ (adjective): realistic and useful. Common phrases: practical advice, practical experience.

items.question: Trong câu "The practical answer: not mandatory, but you must compensate with foundational knowledge.", từ "compensate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The practical answer: not mandatory, but you must compensate with foundational knowledge.", what does "compensate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: compensate /ˈkɑːm.pən.seɪt/ (động từ): bù đắp. "Compensate with/for" = bù đắp bằng/cho; danh từ "compensation" còn nghĩa là tổng thu nhập, đãi ngộ.
items.explanationEn: compensate /ˈkɑːm.pən.seɪt/ (verb): to make up for. "Compensate with/for" means to make up for; the noun "compensation" also means total pay.

items.question: Trong câu "Core IT knowledge — how the web works, what an API is, what a database stores, how systems are layered.", từ "layer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Core IT knowledge — how the web works, what an API is, what a database stores, how systems are layered.", what does "layer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: layer /ˈleɪ.ɚ/ (động từ): chia thành nhiều tầng. Hệ thống "layered" gồm nhiều tầng như giao diện, logic, dữ liệu; danh từ: layer (tầng, lớp).
items.explanationEn: layer /ˈleɪ.ɚ/ (verb): to arrange in levels. A layered system has levels such as UI, logic and data; noun: layer.

items.question: Trong câu "You need not code, but you must read and understand.", từ "need not" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You need not code, but you must read and understand.", what does "need not" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: need not /niːd nɑːt/ (cụm từ): không cần phải. "Need not do" = không cần làm (trang trọng); khác "must not" = không được làm.
items.explanationEn: need not /niːd nɑːt/ (phrase): do not have to. "Need not do" means it is not necessary (formal); unlike "must not", which forbids it.

items.question: Trong câu "Basic SQL — to query data yourself, test assumptions, and build reports without waiting on anyone.", từ "query" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Basic SQL — to query data yourself, test assumptions, and build reports without waiting on anyone.", what does "query" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: query /ˈkwɪr.i/ (động từ): truy vấn dữ liệu. "Query data" = truy vấn dữ liệu bằng SQL; "query a decision" lại là đặt nghi vấn về quyết định.
items.explanationEn: query /ˈkwɪr.i/ (verb): to retrieve data from. "Query data" means retrieving it with SQL; "query a decision" means expressing doubt about it.

items.question: Trong câu "Basic SQL — to query data yourself, test assumptions, and build reports without waiting on anyone.", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Basic SQL — to query data yourself, test assumptions, and build reports without waiting on anyone.", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (danh từ): giả định. Cụm hay gặp: test/validate an assumption (kiểm chứng giả định); động từ: assume.
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (noun): a belief without proof. Common phrases: test or validate an assumption; verb: assume.

items.question: Trong câu "Career changers bring their own advantages:", từ "advantage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Career changers bring their own advantages:", what does "advantage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: advantage /ədˈvæn.t̬ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): lợi thế. Cụm hay gặp: take advantage of (tận dụng); trái nghĩa: disadvantage.
items.explanationEn: advantage /ədˈvæn.t̬ɪdʒ/ (noun): a benefit. Common phrase: take advantage of; opposite: disadvantage.

items.question: Trong câu "Valuable domain knowledge a generalist BA needs years to acquire", từ "acquire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Valuable domain knowledge a generalist BA needs years to acquire", what does "acquire" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: acquire /əˈkwaɪr/ (động từ): tích lũy, đạt được. "Acquire knowledge/skills" = tích lũy kiến thức/kỹ năng; danh từ "acquisition" còn là thương vụ mua lại.
items.explanationEn: acquire /əˈkwaɪr/ (verb): to gain. "Acquire knowledge or skills" means to gain them; the noun "acquisition" also means buying a company.

items.question: Trong câu "Already trained to hunt exception cases and write verifiable criteria", từ "hunt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Already trained to hunt exception cases and write verifiable criteria", what does "hunt" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hunt /hʌnt/ (động từ): truy tìm. Cụm hay gặp: bug hunting (săn lỗi), job hunting (tìm việc).
items.explanationEn: hunt /hʌnt/ (verb): to search hard for. Common phrases: bug hunting, job hunting.

items.question: Trong câu "Already trained to hunt exception cases and write verifiable criteria", từ "verifiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Already trained to hunt exception cases and write verifiable criteria", what does "verifiable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: verifiable /ˈver.ə.faɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể kiểm chứng. Tiêu chí "verifiable" là tiêu chí có thể kiểm tra đúng/sai; động từ: verify.
items.explanationEn: verifiable /ˈver.ə.faɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be checked. Verifiable criteria can be checked as pass or fail; verb: verify.

items.question: Trong câu "Real understanding of user pain and how the process actually runs", từ "pain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Real understanding of user pain and how the process actually runs", what does "pain" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pain /peɪn/ (danh từ): khó khăn, bức xúc. Trong sản phẩm, "user pain" hay "pain point" = vấn đề khiến người dùng khó chịu.
items.explanationEn: pain /peɪn/ (noun): frustration, problems. In product work, "user pain" or "pain point" is a problem that frustrates users.

items.question: Trong câu "In reality your domain knowledge is the hardest thing to teach — analysis technique can be learned in a few months.", từ "in reality" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In reality your domain knowledge is the hardest thing to teach — analysis technique can be learned in a few months.", what does "in reality" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in reality /ɪn riˈæl.ə.t̬i/ (cụm từ): trên thực tế. Dùng để đối lập với điều người ta nghĩ; đồng nghĩa: in fact, actually.
items.explanationEn: in reality /ɪn riˈæl.ə.t̬i/ (phrase): actually. Used to contrast with what people believe; synonyms: in fact, actually.

items.question: Trong câu "In reality your domain knowledge is the hardest thing to teach — analysis technique can be learned in a few months.", từ "domain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In reality your domain knowledge is the hardest thing to teach — analysis technique can be learned in a few months.", what does "domain" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: domain /doʊˈmeɪn/ (danh từ): lĩnh vực nghiệp vụ. "Domain knowledge" = kiến thức nghiệp vụ (ngân hàng, bảo hiểm...); trong web, "domain" là tên miền.
items.explanationEn: domain /doʊˈmeɪn/ (noun): a field of business. "Domain knowledge" is knowledge of a business field such as banking; on the web, a domain is a site address.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most asked question, and the answer is fairly blunt.", từ "blunt" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most asked question, and the answer is fairly blunt.", what does "blunt" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: blunt /blʌnt/ (tính từ): thẳng thắn. "A blunt answer" = câu trả lời thẳng thừng; "a blunt knife" = con dao cùn.
items.explanationEn: blunt /blʌnt/ (adjective): direct and frank. "A blunt answer" is direct and frank; "a blunt knife" is not sharp.

items.question: Trong câu "English is not a condition to START, but it is a condition to GO FAR.", từ "condition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "English is not a condition to START, but it is a condition to GO FAR.", what does "condition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: condition /kənˈdɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): điều kiện. Cụm hay gặp: on condition that (với điều kiện là), working conditions (điều kiện làm việc).
items.explanationEn: condition /kənˈdɪʃ.ən/ (noun): a requirement. Common phrases: on condition that, working conditions.

items.question: Trong câu "Needed from junior upward if the company serves overseas customers", từ "upward" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Needed from junior upward if the company serves overseas customers", what does "upward" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: upward /ˈʌp.wɚd/ (trạng từ): trở lên. "From junior upward" = từ cấp junior trở lên; trái nghĩa: downward.
items.explanationEn: upward /ˈʌp.wɚd/ (adverb): and higher. "From junior upward" means junior level and above; opposite: downward.

items.question: Trong câu "Needed at senior level when defending a position with overseas stakeholders", từ "defend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Needed at senior level when defending a position with overseas stakeholders", what does "defend" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defend /dɪˈfend/ (động từ): bảo vệ, bênh vực. "Defend a position" = bảo vệ quan điểm của mình trước người khác; danh từ: defence/defense.
items.explanationEn: defend /dɪˈfend/ (verb): to argue in support of. "Defend a position" means arguing for your view; noun: defence (US: defense).

items.question: Trong câu "Needed at senior level when defending a position with overseas stakeholders", từ "position" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Needed at senior level when defending a position with overseas stakeholders", what does "position" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: position /pəˈzɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): lập trường, quan điểm. Ở đây "position" là lập trường; cụm: take a position on (bày tỏ lập trường về).
items.explanationEn: position /pəˈzɪʃ.ən/ (noun): a stance on an issue. Here "position" means a stance; phrase: take a position on.

items.question: Trong câu "Why English creates such a salary gap: it opens the entire overseas customer market and international product companies, where pay is markedly higher.", từ "markedly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why English creates such a salary gap: it opens the entire overseas customer market and international product companies, where pay is markedly higher.", what does "markedly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: markedly /ˈmɑːr.kɪd.li/ (trạng từ): rõ rệt. Chú ý phát âm có âm /ɪd/: MAR-kid-ly; tính từ: marked (rõ rệt).
items.explanationEn: markedly /ˈmɑːr.kɪd.li/ (adverb): noticeably. Note the extra syllable: MAR-kid-ly; adjective: marked.

items.question: Trong câu "Practical advice: do not wait until your English is good to apply.", từ "apply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practical advice: do not wait until your English is good to apply.", what does "apply" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to ask formally for a job
items.explanation: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (động từ): nộp đơn xin việc. Cấu trúc: apply for a job (ứng tuyển); apply to (áp dụng cho).
items.explanationEn: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (verb): to ask formally for a job. Patterns: apply for a job; apply to (be relevant to).

items.question: Trong câu "Start in a domestic environment while reading English documentation every day.", từ "environment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Start in a domestic environment while reading English documentation every day.", what does "environment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/ (danh từ): môi trường làm việc. Cụm hay gặp: work environment (môi trường làm việc); trong IT còn có test environment.
items.explanationEn: environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/ (noun): working surroundings. Common phrases: work environment; in IT also test environment.

items.question: Trong câu "Listening and speaking improve fast once you must use them in real work.", từ "improve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Listening and speaking improve fast once you must use them in real work.", what does "improve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: improve /ɪmˈpruːv/ (động từ): tiến bộ, cải thiện. Danh từ: improvement; cụm: continuous improvement (cải tiến liên tục).
items.explanationEn: improve /ɪmˈpruːv/ (verb): to get better. Noun: improvement; phrase: continuous improvement.

items.question: Trong câu "This is a classic interview question, but more importantly it is one to ask yourself.", từ "classic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is a classic interview question, but more importantly it is one to ask yourself.", what does "classic" (adjective) mean?
options: thuộc Hy Lạp - La Mã cổ
items.explanation: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (tính từ): kinh điển, điển hình. "A classic question" = câu hỏi kinh điển, luôn gặp; "classical" mới là cổ điển (classical music).
items.explanationEn: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (adjective): typical and well known. "A classic question" is a typical, well-known one; "classical" is used for ancient or classical music.

items.question: Trong câu "You instinctively ask why repeatedly rather than accepting the first answer.", từ "instinctively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You instinctively ask why repeatedly rather than accepting the first answer.", what does "instinctively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: instinctively /ɪnˈstɪŋk.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): theo bản năng. Danh từ: instinct (bản năng); cụm: trust your instinct (tin vào trực giác).
items.explanationEn: instinctively /ɪnˈstɪŋk.tɪv.li/ (adverb): naturally, without thinking. Noun: instinct; phrase: trust your instinct.

items.question: Trong câu "You instinctively ask why repeatedly rather than accepting the first answer.", từ "repeatedly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You instinctively ask why repeatedly rather than accepting the first answer.", what does "repeatedly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: repeatedly /rɪˈpiː.t̬ɪd.li/ (trạng từ): lặp đi lặp lại. "Ask why repeatedly" gợi đến kỹ thuật "5 Whys" để tìm nguyên nhân gốc.
items.explanationEn: repeatedly /rɪˈpiː.t̬ɪd.li/ (adverb): again and again. "Ask why repeatedly" recalls the 5 Whys technique for finding root causes.

items.question: Trong câu "You are comfortable working in ambiguity and creating order from it.", từ "comfortable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You are comfortable working in ambiguity and creating order from it.", what does "comfortable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: comfortable /ˈkʌm.fɚ.t̬ə.bəl/ (tính từ): thoải mái, không ngại. Cấu trúc: be comfortable (with) doing something = thấy thoải mái khi làm gì.
items.explanationEn: comfortable /ˈkʌm.fɚ.t̬ə.bəl/ (adjective): at ease. Pattern: be comfortable (with) doing something.

items.question: Trong câu "Reasons that lead to disappointment:", từ "disappointment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reasons that lead to disappointment:", what does "disappointment" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a feeling of being let down
items.explanation: disappointment /ˌdɪs.əˈpɔɪnt.mənt/ (danh từ): sự thất vọng. Cụm hay gặp: lead to disappointment (dẫn đến thất vọng); động từ: disappoint.
items.explanationEn: disappointment /ˌdɪs.əˈpɔɪnt.mənt/ (noun): a feeling of being let down. Common phrase: lead to disappointment; verb: disappoint.

items.question: Trong câu "BA is not an escape from technology; you still need deep technical understanding.", từ "escape" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BA is not an escape from technology; you still need deep technical understanding.", what does "escape" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: escape /ɪˈskeɪp/ (danh từ): lối thoát, sự né tránh. "An escape from" = cách trốn tránh điều gì; BA không phải lối thoát khỏi công nghệ.
items.explanationEn: escape /ɪˈskeɪp/ (noun): a way to avoid something. "An escape from" is a way to avoid something; BA is not a way to avoid technology.

items.question: Trong câu "It carries pressure from every side and responsibility without authority.", từ "pressure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It carries pressure from every side and responsibility without authority.", what does "pressure" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pressure /ˈpreʃ.ɚ/ (danh từ): áp lực. Cụm hay gặp: under pressure (chịu áp lực), put pressure on (gây áp lực lên).
items.explanationEn: pressure /ˈpreʃ.ɚ/ (noun): stress from demands. Common phrases: under pressure, put pressure on.

items.question: Trong câu "take an app you use daily and write 10 questions a BA would ask about one of its features.", từ "daily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "take an app you use daily and write 10 questions a BA would ask about one of its features.", what does "daily" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: daily /ˈdeɪ.li/ (trạng từ): hằng ngày. "Daily" vừa là tính từ (daily standup) vừa là trạng từ (use it daily).
items.explanationEn: daily /ˈdeɪ.li/ (adverb): every day. "Daily" is both an adjective (daily standup) and an adverb (use it daily).

items.question: Trong câu "If that feels interesting rather than tiring, it is a good sign.", từ "tiring" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If that feels interesting rather than tiring, it is a good sign.", what does "tiring" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tiring /ˈtaɪr.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): gây mệt mỏi. Phân biệt: tiring (gây mệt) và tired (cảm thấy mệt).
items.explanationEn: tiring /ˈtaɪr.ɪŋ/ (adjective): making you tired. Compare: tiring (causing tiredness) and tired (feeling it).

items.question: Trong câu "This is a realistic path, not an idealised one:", từ "realistic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is a realistic path, not an idealised one:", what does "realistic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: realistic /ˌriː.əˈlɪs.tɪk/ (tính từ): thực tế, khả thi. Cụm hay gặp: realistic goal (mục tiêu khả thi), realistic timeline.
items.explanationEn: realistic /ˌriː.əˈlɪs.tɪk/ (adjective): practical and achievable. Common phrases: realistic goal, realistic timeline.

items.question: Trong câu "This is a realistic path, not an idealised one:", từ "idealised" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is a realistic path, not an idealised one:", what does "idealised" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: idealised /aɪˈdiː.ə.laɪzd/ (tính từ): được lý tưởng hóa. Viết kiểu Mỹ: idealized; "an idealised path" = lộ trình hoàn hảo trên giấy nhưng khó thực hiện.
items.explanationEn: idealised /aɪˈdiː.ə.laɪzd/ (adjective): made to seem perfect. American spelling: idealized; an idealised path looks perfect on paper but is hard to follow.

items.question: Trong câu "Goal: specify one complete feature by yourself.", từ "specify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Goal: specify one complete feature by yourself.", what does "specify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: specify /ˈspes.ə.faɪ/ (động từ): đặc tả, nêu cụ thể. Danh từ: specification (bản đặc tả, spec).
items.explanationEn: specify /ˈspes.ə.faɪ/ (verb): to describe in detail. Noun: specification (spec).

items.question: Trong câu "Goal: specify one complete feature by yourself.", từ "by yourself" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Goal: specify one complete feature by yourself.", what does "by yourself" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by yourself /baɪ jɚˈself/ (cụm từ): tự mình. "By yourself" = tự làm, không có ai giúp; đồng nghĩa: on your own.
items.explanationEn: by yourself /baɪ jɚˈself/ (phrase): alone. "By yourself" means alone, without help; synonym: on your own.

items.question: Trong câu "pick a real application and write the analysis documentation as if you were its BA.", từ "application" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "pick a real application and write the analysis documentation as if you were its BA.", what does "application" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: application /ˌæp.ləˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): ứng dụng phần mềm. Ở đây "application" = ứng dụng; "job application" lại là đơn xin việc.
items.explanationEn: application /ˌæp.ləˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a software program. Here "application" means software; a job application is a request for a job.

items.question: Trong câu "pick a real application and write the analysis documentation as if you were its BA.", từ "as if" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "pick a real application and write the analysis documentation as if you were its BA.", what does "as if" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: as if /æz ɪf/ (liên từ): như thể. Sau "as if" thường dùng quá khứ giả định: as if you were its BA.
items.explanationEn: as if /æz ɪf/ (conjunction): as though. After "as if", English often uses the subjunctive past: as if you were its BA.

items.question: Trong câu "Polish a portfolio from that project, rehearse interview questions, and study one specific domain.", từ "polish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Polish a portfolio from that project, rehearse interview questions, and study one specific domain.", what does "polish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: polish /ˈpɑː.lɪʃ/ (động từ): trau chuốt, hoàn thiện. Nghĩa bóng: polish a CV/portfolio (trau chuốt hồ sơ); chú ý "Polish" viết hoa là "thuộc Ba Lan".
items.explanationEn: polish /ˈpɑː.lɪʃ/ (verb): to refine and improve. Figuratively: polish a CV or portfolio; note capitalised "Polish" means from Poland.

items.question: Trong câu "Polish a portfolio from that project, rehearse interview questions, and study one specific domain.", từ "portfolio" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Polish a portfolio from that project, rehearse interview questions, and study one specific domain.", what does "portfolio" (noun) mean?
options: hồ sơ sản phẩm cá nhân
items.explanation: portfolio /pɔːrtˈfoʊ.li.oʊ/ (danh từ): hồ sơ sản phẩm cá nhân. Portfolio của BA là bộ tài liệu phân tích mẫu chứng minh năng lực; trong tài chính là danh mục đầu tư.
items.explanationEn: portfolio /pɔːrtˈfoʊ.li.oʊ/ (noun): a collection of your work. A BA portfolio is a set of sample analysis documents; in finance a portfolio is a set of investments.

items.question: Trong câu "Polish a portfolio from that project, rehearse interview questions, and study one specific domain.", từ "rehearse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Polish a portfolio from that project, rehearse interview questions, and study one specific domain.", what does "rehearse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rehearse /rɪˈhɝːs/ (động từ): tập dượt trước. Danh từ: rehearsal (buổi tập dượt); cụm: rehearse answers (tập trả lời trước).
items.explanationEn: rehearse /rɪˈhɝːs/ (verb): to practise beforehand. Noun: rehearsal; phrase: rehearse answers.

items.question: Trong câu "Polish a portfolio from that project, rehearse interview questions, and study one specific domain.", từ "specific" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Polish a portfolio from that project, rehearse interview questions, and study one specific domain.", what does "specific" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (tính từ): cụ thể. Trạng từ: specifically; trái nghĩa: general, vague.
items.explanationEn: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (adjective): particular. Adverb: specifically; opposites: general, vague.

items.question: Trong câu "The biggest differentiator in a fresher interview is not a certificate but something you built yourself and can talk about for twenty minutes.", từ "differentiator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The biggest differentiator in a fresher interview is not a certificate but something you built yourself and can talk about for twenty minutes.", what does "differentiator" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: differentiator /ˌdɪf.əˈren.ʃi.eɪ.t̬ɚ/ (danh từ): yếu tố tạo khác biệt. Động từ: differentiate (phân biệt, tạo khác biệt); cụm: key differentiator.
items.explanationEn: differentiator /ˌdɪf.əˈren.ʃi.eɪ.t̬ɚ/ (noun): what sets you apart. Verb: differentiate; phrase: key differentiator.

items.question: Trong câu "The biggest differentiator in a fresher interview is not a certificate but something you built yourself and can talk about for twenty minutes.", từ "certificate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The biggest differentiator in a fresher interview is not a certificate but something you built yourself and can talk about for twenty minutes.", what does "certificate" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an official proof of a course
items.explanation: certificate /sɚˈtɪf.ɪ.kət/ (danh từ): chứng chỉ. Cụm hay gặp: earn a certificate (đạt chứng chỉ); danh từ liên quan: certification.
items.explanationEn: certificate /sɚˈtɪf.ɪ.kət/ (noun): an official proof of a course. Common phrase: earn a certificate; related noun: certification.

items.question: Trong câu "A set of analysis documents for a real application — even as a self-set exercise — proves you can do the work.", từ "exercise" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A set of analysis documents for a real application — even as a self-set exercise — proves you can do the work.", what does "exercise" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: exercise /ˈek.sɚ.saɪz/ (danh từ): bài tập thực hành. "A self-set exercise" = bài tập tự đặt ra; "exercise" còn là tập thể dục.
items.explanationEn: exercise /ˈek.sɚ.saɪz/ (noun): a practice task. "A self-set exercise" is a practice task you set yourself; "exercise" also means physical activity.

items.question: Trong câu "A set of analysis documents for a real application — even as a self-set exercise — proves you can do the work.", từ "prove" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A set of analysis documents for a real application — even as a self-set exercise — proves you can do the work.", what does "prove" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prove /pruːv/ (động từ): chứng minh. Danh từ: proof (bằng chứng); cụm: prove yourself (chứng tỏ bản thân).
items.explanationEn: prove /pruːv/ (verb): to show to be true. Noun: proof; phrase: prove yourself.

items.question: Trong câu "Career changers have an edge: domain knowledge is the hardest thing to teach, while analysis technique takes months.", từ "edge" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Career changers have an edge: domain knowledge is the hardest thing to teach, while analysis technique takes months.", what does "edge" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: edge /edʒ/ (danh từ): lợi thế. "Have an edge (over)" = có lợi thế (so với); nghĩa đen là mép, cạnh.
items.explanationEn: edge /edʒ/ (noun): an advantage. "Have an edge (over)" means to have an advantage; literally, a border or rim.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA career has a clear ladder and many onward paths, so it rarely becomes a dead end.", từ "dead end" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA career has a clear ladder and many onward paths, so it rarely becomes a dead end.", what does "dead end" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a route with no way on
items.explanation: dead end /ˌded ˈend/ (danh từ): ngõ cụt. Cụm hay gặp: dead-end job (công việc không có tương lai).
items.explanationEn: dead end /ˌded ˈend/ (noun): a route with no way on. Common phrase: dead-end job (a job with no future).

items.question: Trong câu "Pay rises with the ability to handle ambiguity, domain knowledge, and English — all three take time to accumulate.", từ "accumulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pay rises with the ability to handle ambiguity, domain knowledge, and English — all three take time to accumulate.", what does "accumulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accumulate /əˈkjuː.mjə.leɪt/ (động từ): tích lũy. Danh từ: accumulation; cụm: accumulate experience (tích lũy kinh nghiệm).
items.explanationEn: accumulate /əˈkjuː.mjə.leɪt/ (verb): to build up. Noun: accumulation; phrase: accumulate experience.

items.question: Trong câu "Career changers are not at a disadvantage, provided they add the IT foundations and analysis technique.", từ "at a disadvantage" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Career changers are not at a disadvantage, provided they add the IT foundations and analysis technique.", what does "at a disadvantage" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at a disadvantage /æt ə ˌdɪs.ədˈvæn.t̬ɪdʒ/ (cụm từ): ở thế bất lợi. Trái nghĩa: at an advantage (ở thế có lợi).
items.explanationEn: at a disadvantage /æt ə ˌdɪs.ədˈvæn.t̬ɪdʒ/ (phrase): in a weaker position. Opposite: at an advantage.

items.question: Trong câu "Career changers are not at a disadvantage, provided they add the IT foundations and analysis technique.", từ "provided" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Career changers are not at a disadvantage, provided they add the IT foundations and analysis technique.", what does "provided" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: provided /prəˈvaɪ.dɪd/ (liên từ): miễn là, với điều kiện. "Provided (that)" = miễn là; đồng nghĩa: as long as, providing.
items.explanationEn: provided /prəˈvaɪ.dɪd/ (conjunction): on condition that. "Provided (that)" means on condition that; synonyms: as long as, providing.
